reviews.review: Great game with a great community! they are always adding new content and are very interactive with the fans. Play it!

this is a great little indie game. so much fun to play with friends. very little that i found lacking.

Edit: this went from being a neat indie game i sometimes played to being my favorite game of all time pretty quickly. There are so many things that i love about this game, so im gonna just make a little list of awesome stuff DRG has going for it real quick:

-it has fantastic drop in/ drop out multiplayer that never fails to be entertaining, and has a big emphasis on teamwork. it might get slightly repetitive at times, but thats what the harder hazards are for, making it more of an interesting challenge. 

-dlcs are completely optional cosmetic packs that you can get to support the devs. they have yet to put one single feature behind a paywall, and i doubt they ever will. 

-battle pass is 100 percent free, and refreshes when a new themed season drops. the passes contain cosmetics, crafting supplies and credits, and the best part is that anything that you cant get in the current season is placed inside randomly spawning cargo crates that you can find scatted around in missions. 

-the visuals, art direction and sound direction are amazing. they did a great job creating a very vivid environment that is never the same as the last thanks to the caves being randomly generated. the feedback from killing bugs is very satisfying, they just blow apart into a big mess of guts.

-the weapons are all very unique, and all useful in their own ways. they also have lots of ways to customize the guns to make them more fitting to your particular playstyle. 

-4 playable classes, and they're all very fun to play. some of them do certain jobs better than others, but they can all be played solo very easily. 

the game does have some downsides, im gonna list them off as well:

-the multiplayer has gotten a bit unstable for a portion of players since the last themed update, causing them to desync, get horrible lag or just crash the game altogether. although the devs have tried to fix this in several patches, its still an ongoing problem for a small number of players. 

-the game can feel somewhat repetitive at times, with there being a limited amount of objectives, weapons, player characters and biomes to mess with. the missions can still be interesting with all the random stuff that happens, but i can see where a person would get tired of the gameplay loop pretty easily. 

-some of the equipment feels a little unbalanced, over or under performing at times depending on the thing in question. the devs do try to balance stuff though, and modders have also taken the time to change up some of the equipment to try and spice it up. 

-like any game, this one can have toxic players. they have been known to kick people that dont do things fast enough, or are focusing on an objective that they dont deem important. these players aren't that common, but it does happen and can definitely hurt the gameplay experience. 

thats all i really have to say about the game at the moment. like all games, it has good and bad aspects, but in my humble opinion, i think the good far outweighs the bad. this is a must have for people that like PvE shooters. 

Rock and Stone.
